name: Project Zomboid
description: The hardcore isometric zombie survival sandbox. Dedicated server installed via SteamCMD (anonymous).

variables.label: Server/world name
variables.description: Name of the server config and save set (no spaces).

variables.label: Admin password
variables.description: Password for the in-game 'admin' account (set non-interactively on first boot).

variables.label: Game port (UDP)
variables.description: Must match DefaultPort in the server .ini (default 16261).

variables.label: Direct connection port (UDP)
variables.description: Second UDP port, default game port + 1.

notes: Passing -adminpassword avoids the interactive admin-password prompt on first boot. Server config and saves are stored in ~/Zomboid/ (Server/<name>.ini, Saves/Multiplayer/) — outside the server directory, so panel backups do not include them by default; add -cachedir=./Zomboid to the start command to keep them local. Windows hosts: set the start command override to StartServer64.bat with the same arguments.
